To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the fuzzy inference rules are generated automatically from input data; (2) the membership functions are defined semi automatically from the generated fuzzy inference rules; (3) a decision support system is built for reshoring decision-making; (4) the system is validated by comparing its recommendations with those of relocation experts.
the proposed semi automatic generation of a fuzzy inference system can be applied to generate a fuzzy inference system for a reshoring context.
a semi automatically configured fuzzy system can be as accurate as a manually configured system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a fuzzy inference system for reshoring decisions, which has been configured automatically.
the semi automatic generation of a fuzzy inference system in a reshoring context.
the semi automatic generation of a fuzzy inference system that can be used to support relocation experts in their daily work.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the semi automatically configured decision support system can be used as an effective tool to support reshoring decisions in high cost countries.

the semi automatic fuzzy inference system presented in this paper is able to generate a set of reshoring decision recommendations that are at least as accurate as those generated by an expert relocation consultant.
the proposed decision support system is a valuable tool in reshoring decision support.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a decision support system based on fuzzy inference systems is able to support the relocation expert in a high cost environment, where cost is only one of many criteria to take into account.
the semi automatic fuzzy inference system is a useful tool for decision makers in the reshoring context, as it provides a high degree of accuracy in a short amount of time.
a semi automatic approach can be applied in order to generate a fuzzy inference system for reshoring decisions, which is as accurate as a manually generated system, but with less effort.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a semi automatic fuzzy inference system can provide decision support in reshoring decision making.
the semi automatic generation of a fuzzy inference system can significantly reduce the manual effort in reshoring decision making and, thus, the time to market of a relocation project.
the semi automatic approach to fuzzy inference system generation provides an effective and efficient way for building decision support systems in a reshoring context.
